# 拾序 v0.2.0 · 留一点字，给今天 📖

新增「随手记」与「窗外的天气」，在安排事情之外，也给自己的想法留一点空间。

- 随笔自动保存，支持可选心情、同日多篇、日期回看、搜索和回收站恢复。
- 自选城市，显示今明天气、降雨概率与穿衣建议；默认保留「选择城市」。
- 断网时标注天气缓存；随笔与日程仍保存在本机，不发送给天气服务。
- v0.1 日程可以直接读取，JSON 备份与追加导入已包含随笔。

下载下方 ZIP，完整解压后运行 `拾序.exe`。升级前导出备份并退出托盘程序，再替换程序目录；不要用 v0.1 写入新版数据目录。

## English

Adds an autosaving journal with optional moods, dated history, search, multiple entries per day, and recovery. Optional city weather shows today's and tomorrow's forecasts with simple clothing suggestions. No city or journal entries are preselected. Only city queries/coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo.

Extract the complete ZIP and run `拾序.exe`. Export a backup before updating, exit the tray application, and replace the application folder. Existing v0.1 records are migrated; do not write the new data directory using the old application.

Windows x64 · Simplified Chinese UI · Unsigned · Manual updates. Task times remain UTC+8; weather uses the city's timezone. Weather is a card, not an additional system notification. Free weather access is for non-commercial use; data is CC BY 4.0. See the [README](https://github.com/womeimingzi/shixu#readme) for details.
